text: OI! LISTEN UP! That bunker decision in the Grand Final was the single biggest robbery in Australian sporting history and I've got the receipts, mate. RECEIPTS!
action: Slams both palms on the desk, knocking his headphones sideways, then jabs a finger straight down the barrel of the mic like a courtroom prosecutor

text: Yeah, nah. Ya said 'receipts' but all I can see on that iPad is a Macca's order from Tuesday.
action: Slowly tilts his head to peer at Boomer's tablet, blinks once, then takes a long unhurried sip from his stubby holder

text: Nah nah nah, SCROLL DOWN, Kev! Frame forty-two! His pinky finger's a bee's dick off the sideline and they called it OUT. There's a bloke in that bunker with a grudge, I reckon — and I'll tell ya exactly who by the end of this ep.
action: Leans across the desk shadow boxing the air twice, then swipes furiously at the tablet with one paw while wiping sweat off his brow with the other

text: Before ya name him and we get sued into next Tuesday... aren't you meant to read the ad? The bloke's paid us in stubby holders again.
action: Yawns, stretches one arm behind his head, and lazily slides a crumpled sponsor card across the desk to Boomer without looking at him

text: BLOODY OATH! This ep's brought to ya by REF-VISION: the prescription goggles for blokes who make terrible decisions! Fair dinkum, chuck 'em on ya mother-in-law, chuck 'em on the bunker — GAME CHANGER! Also if any REAL sponsor's watchin', we are flat out like a lizard drinkin' and we work for snacks.
action: Whips a pair of enormous novelty goggles from under the desk, wears them crooked, and flexes one bicep directly into the camera lens

text: Mate, they're servo sunnies with the price tag still on. Ground control to Boomer — nobody's buyin' that, and nobody's suin' the bunker either.
action: Reaches over, flicks the dangling price tag on the goggles, then leans back into his chair and lets out a dry wheezing laugh

text: So you're tellin' me a grand final gets decided by a bloke squintin' at a pixel in a dark room in Eveleigh and we all just... cop it sweet?!
action: Throws both arms wide, rolls his chair back, then rolls forward and grips the mic stand with both paws like he's about to propose to it

text: Yeah. Ya do. 'Cos here's ya grand conspiracy, mate — the bunker bloke's name is Dave, he's on twenty-two bucks an hour, and he barracks for neither side. Your team lost 'cos they dropped it cold four times in the second half. Wrap this up.
action: Sets his stubby holder down with a soft clunk, slow-blinks once directly at camera, and pulls the gum leaf out of his mouth mid-chew
